events.fact: Xero OAuth apps are created in the Xero Developer Portal at developer.xero.com under My Apps, requiring a free Xero user account.
To publish an app on the Xero App Store for general third-party access, developers must become a certified app partner and onboard 10 beta customers actively using the integration.
Xero certification requires implementing Sign Up with Xero, passing security and technical reviews, and meeting annual recertification standards.

Unapproved developer apps are limited by tenant connection caps based on developer pricing tiers (e.g., Starter plan allows 5 connections) and rate limits of 60 calls per minute and 5 concurrent calls per connection.
Xero transitioned to granular scopes for the Accounting API (effective March 2026 for new apps), replacing broad scopes like accounting.transactions with specific ones like accounting.invoices.
Xero OAuth access tokens expire after 30 minutes, and refresh tokens expire after 60 days of inactivity with mandatory refresh token rotation.

Verdict drafted: Xero provides instant self-serve developer access, but publishing an app for general use requires formal certification and 10 active beta customers.
